request: Analyze GSE280656 for PMID 40000838 (Short-term overloading exercise attenuates articular chondrocyte features partly via synovium-cartilage interactions mediated by inhibin subunit beta A.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Effect of overloading exercise (treadmill + 20 g weight) on the synovium transcriptome at 1, 4, 24 h after a single bout (S1, S4, S24) and 24 h after 4 daily bouts (R24), each versus non-running controls; plus adjacent time-point comparisons
final.inclusion: male C57BL/6J, 10-13 wk; each RNA-seq sample is a pool (synovium 6 knees, cartilage 9 knees); no exclusions (S4.1.p1, S4.4.p1)
final.paper_method: iDEP web app (default DESeq2 on RSEM counts across all groups), FDR < 0.1 and fold change > 2 (S4.4.p2)
final.paper_results: DEG counts per comparison only in Fig 2b (numbers not in text); overlaps: synovium S1&S4 vs control share 52 DEGs, S4&S24 share 9, common S1/S4/S24 = Clec4d, Calca, Ecel1, Saa3 (S2.3.p2); cartilage S1&S4 share 32, S4&S24 share 5, 11 common incl Wnt1, Tnf, Saa3 (S2.4.p2); R24 vs control >> S24 vs control DEGs (S2.5.p1)
